authoritative_target.title: From Complementarity to Actionability: Observability and Cost-Aware Routing in Drug Repurposing

paper_claims.claim: Average performance can conceal disease-specific expert complementarity.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Numbers are frozen targets, not new calculations. Oracle CSV must be comparison-only.

paper_claims.claim: PrimeKG connects biomedical entities; TxGNN and algorithm-selection/metareasoning literature motivate the study, not new comparative TxGNN results.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Cited works on page 6 are bibliography, not empirical study outputs. No TxGNN result is claimed.

paper_claims.claim: SBS maximizes disease-macro expert utility; VBS selects each disease with held-out outcomes; oracle gap is an upper bound, not a deployable policy.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Equations (1) and (2) and the conceptual upper-bound restriction are retained; no oracle code executed.

paper_claims.claim: Observability, held-out decision value and resource feasibility are separate requirements; a positive gap does not establish practical model selection.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Limited to tested representations/policies; does not assert routing impossibility.

paper_claims.claim: One frozen PrimeKG snapshot, disease cold start: 738 diseases, 7957 shared candidates, 8368 CLEAN truth pairs; no sampled negative evaluation.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Independent raw reconstruction is prior Gate-2B evidence; raw graph absent.

paper_claims.claim: At least three CLEAN positives per disease; ambiguous indications, off-label-only and conflicting nonindications excluded from primary positives.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Excluded from primary ranking under the frozen metric roles; contraindications remain rankable safety annotations and unobserved pairs remain unlabeled.

paper_claims.claim: Eight deterministic disease-level OOF partitions with split seed 42; diseases, not pairs, held out.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Quarantine union is verified; raw-edge completeness is not re-enumerated here.

paper_claims.claim: Indication/contraindication/off-label relations stripped before fold-legal supervision; nontherapeutic structure retained.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Frozen mask and corpus contracts checked; prior Gates 2B/6A establish raw reconstruction. Full raw graph not read here.

paper_claims.claim: Canonical masking withholds therapeutic labels of targets and indication-bearing direct ontology neighbors; scoped hidden-label/ontology audits found zero leaks.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Direct shortcut audit only; no universal leakage-free claim. Frozen quarantine completeness relies on prior raw Gate-2B evidence.

paper_claims.claim: This is retrospective withheld-indication evaluation in one snapshot, not future indications or prospective therapeutic efficacy.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Submitted paper wording must be checked before making a paper-coverage claim.

paper_claims.claim: E1 weighted gene cosine and E2 nontherapeutic disease-profile transfer are deterministic; E3 ComplEx and E4 R-GCN use permitted graph/supervision.
paper_claims.resolution_note: E1/E2 clean algorithms verified at prior gates; E3 preparation only; E4 metadata/source records, not clean fresh training.

paper_claims.claim: Stochastic utilities average disease metrics over seeds 0/1/2 before taking expert maxima; never average seed-specific maxima or raw logits.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Three actual seeds are 0/1/2; paper equation indexes the three members as s=1..3.

paper_claims.claim: Recall@50 is positive hits among top50 divided by CLEAN truths, with equal disease weight; SBS/VBS and oracle gap follow equations (1)/(2).
paper_claims.resolution_note: Scores not re-evaluated during this gate; no biological-negative or efficacy interpretation.

paper_claims.claim: Explicit abstention retains zero utility; zero numerical scores alone do not imply abstention; exact ties use expected uniform random ordering.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Scores not re-evaluated during this gate; no biological-negative or efficacy interpretation.

paper_claims.claim: Seven metrics are Recall@10/50/100, Hit@10/50/100, MRR.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Historical Cell 27 is recovered per reconciliation, but source bytes absent and paper metric/figure scope unconfirmed.

paper_claims.claim: Target-only, canonical1hop and strict2hop remove therapeutic supervision to increasing ontology radius.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Variant definitions historical; only canonical clean mask is implemented. Table3 variant counts remain separately unresolved.

paper_claims.claim: Protocol comparisons use paired reruns; headline and candidate-universe results use original canonical runs.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Distinct lineages kept; paired canonical VBS0.6815756091 is not original0.6813512111.

paper_claims.claim: Static v1/v2 use 41/68 pre-label descriptors, no therapeutic outcomes as query-time inputs; v2 adds 27 multiscale/support descriptors.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Frozen closure supports counts; source/feature tables required to independently re-audit feature legality and exact definitions.

paper_claims.claim: Static evaluation uses eight outer folds; Ridge predicts alternative-minus-E2 deltas for E1/E3/E4; HGB also tested.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Equation (3) is inventoried; closure also describes absolute-utility v1 and conservative direct-delta policies. Exact policy-to-result attribution requires unbundled configurations/predictions; do not silently identify v1 absolute scores as direct-delta results.

paper_claims.claim: One-standard-error threshold selection within outer-training partitions; preprocessing/calibration training-only, held-out queries use legal features.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Frozen protocols support intended rule; no fresh fit or held-out audit executed.

paper_claims.claim: Warm cost measures score/rank with state loaded, excluding training, reusable preprocessing, setup and loading; serving cost is implementation dependent.
paper_claims.resolution_note: E1/E2 timing hardware unknown; costs are hardware/context dependent and not prospective deployment measurements.

paper_claims.claim: Gate A is cost-constrained hindsight oracle; Gate B is learned escalation from E2; default runs then optional alternative replaces ranking.
paper_claims.resolution_note: Gate-A scope differs from a deployable policy; tiny scalar round-trip differences vs P1 summary must be preserved, not silently normalized.

paper_claims.claim: Gate B has712 E2-applicable diseases,570 development and142 sealed test;5 outer folds with4 inner folds.
paper_claims.resolution_note: No new P1/HGB fit, threshold search or META_TEST membership/outcome read. Development population is 570, not full 738.
